page.layout: One page of text, two columns: the verse runs full width in lines, with a short passage of text on the left and a mark below the text at the right; no marginal notes. Running head at the top centre. Page number top right. Signature mark at lower right of text block.

main_text.p: Iô Christe! tibi gloria, laus, honor, Hymnus, voce, manu, corpore, mente q;

p.i: Robusti iuuenes, cana senum cohors, Nupta, virginei cum pueris chori, Cum lucis spatijs iungite tempora Noctis, rure, domi, psallite, psallite.

Plaudant templa nouis vndique Canticis: Priuataq; domus vndique personent: Sylua cum rigidis montibus accinant: Respondent fluuij. Nereé (qui tuis Constringis fluidis littora brachiis Quæ sol cunq; videt) fer citus Indicis Aurora populis, Hesperijs citus Extremis hominum, cælite quæ manu Sunt patrata tuo nuper in æquore: Et quæ contuitus luminibus, potes Non audita modo, visa sed edere.
Nec vero galeas scutaque fortium Vrgeto memorans corpora vel virûm, Gazæ diuitis aut scrinia plurima, Quæ vento & pelago ludibrium luunt: Vndas purpureas sanguine, contice,

main_text.p: Ergo quid referes? Hoc simul omnibus: Eo i, Occidui, sub Medio die, Fastus Tartareos gentis Iberica Quotquot ferre graues cogimini, MANY Cœlesti domiti, virgine sunt duce, Arcto sub gelida, viribus Anglicis.

page.notes: The Latin verse is printed in italic. The numbers 1 and the catchword are not present. Several words are doubtful at the scan's blur: "Hesperijs" and "contuitus" are read as printed; the heading word "MANY" is printed in small capitals within the line. The signature "B. ÿ." is at the foot right. Some letter forms (long s, s) are plain s as instructed.
